description: This file defines a React component 'ExploreMindmapView' that visualizes career roles in a mind map, fetches recommendations via API calls, manages state and filters, and renders visualization and details panels.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a trimmed string, handling nullish values.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of strings, filtering out empty strings.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a role object.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title string from a role object.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between a min and max value.

methods.name: parseSalaryRangeToLakhs
methods.description: Parses a salary string to numeric min/max values in lakhs.

methods.name: roleMatchesFilters
methods.description: Determines if a role matches selected industry, skills, and salary filters.

methods.name: fetchRecommendations
methods.description: Fetches role recommendations based on persona ID, with fallback behavior.

methods.name: toViewport
methods.description: Converts view state to viewport parameters.

methods.name: toState
methods.description: Converts viewport parameters and selected node ID to view state.
